_quic_lib_note: Option B: External CLI (curl --http3) over new Node dependency. Rationale: keeps package.json clean, consistent with using external tools (dnctl, pfctl), no native bindings to maintain.
_phone_leg_note: Option B: Run identical CLI client from MacBook Pro over Tailscale. Rationale: fully automatable today, validates harness before needing real phone hardware, battery measurements deferred to follow-up ticket.
_headscale_deploy_note: Option B: Paper comparison only from Headscale docs/threat model. Rationale: no machinery overhead for measurement, threat model is well-documented, consistent with KISS principle.
_variant_c_auth_note: Option C: Scope variant (c) as 'trusted local network only'. Rationale: variant (c) fundamentally has different threat model than Tailscale-based variants; avoids adding complexity (TLS certs) or secret management (tokens); clear about scope.
